cc_customer.description: An individual or entity that purchases food products or services from the business

senses.description: A customer with an active account who has made at least one purchase
A potential customer who has shown interest but not yet made a purchase
A customer with an active subscription for recurring deliveries

cc_customer.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query CRM system for customer records, subscription status, and purchase history

cc_order.description: A request for food products or meal kits placed by a customer

senses.description: A single purchase order for immediate fulfillment
The initial order placed by a new customer

cc_order.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query order management system for order details, status, and fulfillment data

cc_subscription.description: A recurring service agreement for regular delivery of meal kits or food products

senses.description: A subscription that is currently active and generating scheduled deliveries
A subscription temporarily suspended by customer request

cc_subscription.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query subscription management system for subscription status, schedules, and customer preferences

cc_kit.description: A pre-packaged collection of ingredients and instructions for preparing a meal

senses.description: A complete kit containing all ingredients and recipe for a specific meal
A kit focused on specific ingredients or cooking techniques

cc_kit.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query menu planning system for kit specifications, ingredients, and production schedules

cc_ingredient.description: Raw materials and food components used in meal preparation and kit assembly

senses.description: Perishable ingredients requiring refrigeration and quick turnover
Non-perishable ingredients with longer shelf life
Unique or premium ingredients requiring special sourcing

cc_ingredient.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query inventory and supplier systems for ingredient specifications, stock levels, and quality data

cc_supplier.description: External vendors and producers who provide ingredients and materials to the business

senses.description: Main suppliers for core ingredients with established contracts
Alternative suppliers used for contingency or overflow capacity

cc_supplier.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query supplier management system for vendor details, contracts, and performance metrics

cc_delivery.description: The physical transportation and handoff of orders or kits to customers

senses.description: Planned delivery with specific time window and route optimization
Expedited delivery for urgent or premium service requests

cc_delivery.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query logistics system for delivery schedules, routes, and completion status

cc_feedback.description: Customer input regarding product quality, service experience, or improvement suggestions

senses.description: Comments specifically about food quality, taste, or kit contents
Comments about delivery, customer service, or overall experience

cc_feedback.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query CRM system for customer feedback records, ratings, and sentiment analysis

cc_improvement.description: Process, product, or service enhancements implemented based on analysis and feedback

senses.description: Changes to operational workflows and procedures
Enhancements to recipes, ingredients, or kit composition

cc_improvement.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query process management system for improvement initiatives, implementation status, and impact metrics

cc_quality_standard.description: Defined criteria and requirements for food safety, ingredient quality, and service delivery

senses.description: Requirements for safe food handling, storage, and preparation
Specifications for ingredient freshness, sourcing, and composition

cc_quality_standard.dataAcquisitionPlan: Query quality management system for standards documentation, compliance records, and audit results

pc_food_safety_compliance.name: Food Safety Compliance Policy
pc_food_safety_compliance.description: Mandatory food safety standards and procedures must be followed throughout food production and handling

outcomes.description: Must maintain cold chain for fresh ingredients
Must document temperature logs and quality checks
Cannot use ingredients past expiration date

pc_supplier_qualification.name: Supplier Qualification Requirements
pc_supplier_qualification.description: All suppliers must meet quality standards and certification requirements before being approved

conditions.expression: cc_quality_standard:Ingredient Quality Standard must be verified

outcomes.description: Must verify supplier certifications and quality standards
Must conduct supplier audit before approval

pc_customer_data_protection.name: Customer Data Protection Policy
pc_customer_data_protection.description: Customer personal information and preferences must be protected and used only for authorized purposes

conditions.expression: cc_customer:Active Customer data is being processed

outcomes.description: Must obtain explicit consent for data collection and use
Must encrypt and secure customer data in transit and at rest
Cannot share customer data with unauthorized third parties

pc_subscription_modification.name: Subscription Modification Guidelines
pc_subscription_modification.description: Customer subscription changes must be processed within defined timeframes and with proper notification

outcomes.description: Must process subscription changes within 24 hours
Must send confirmation notification to customer
May offer alternative options if requested change is not available

pc_feedback_response.name: Customer Feedback Response Requirements
pc_feedback_response.description: All customer feedback must be acknowledged and addressed according to severity and type

outcomes.description: Must acknowledge feedback within 2 business hours
Must escalate quality issues to product management
Must track feedback resolution and customer satisfaction
